calls.thesis: Leaning HOLD: fairly valued Dutch insurer, 5% dividend yield + €350M/yr buybacks, 224% solvency ratio buffer; he is up 86% on it (4.4% community-portfolio weight). Would buy under €65, sell over €86.
calls.base_case: Normal scenario: ~4% earnings growth → ~7.7%/yr return, fair value €84.

calls.bear_case: Negative scenario: 1% growth, PE 9.7 in 10y → fair €62; saturated insurance market, low ROE.
